title: DataSage Ground Truth Corruption Manifest
description: Produced by data/generators/corrupt_data.py. Records every defect deliberately injected into data/corrupted/, keyed by the stable row_uid that survives unchanged from data/clean/. This is the answer key detector_eval.py grades detector output against.

seed.description: The EVAL_RANDOM_SEED used to generate this manifest. Re-running the generators with the same seed must reproduce this file byte-for-byte.

table.description: Which table this defect was injected into, e.g. "customers", "orders".

row_uid.description: The stable identifier of the affected row. MUST match a row_uid present in the corresponding data/clean/<table>.csv file — this is what makes row-level grading possible.

column.description: The affected column name, or null for a row-level defect (e.g. duplicate_row) that isn't localized to one column.

defect_type.description: One of the closed set of defect types this project's corruption script produces. Should correspond to a detector's issue_type in the detector contract (see detector_contract.py) for the manifest to be gradeable — an ungraded defect_type is not a bug, just not yet covered by a detector.

original_value.description: The value before corruption. null for row-level defects.

corrupted_value.description: The value after corruption. null for row-level defects.
